verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no listing of Jev on any independent third-party benchmark, evaluation suite, or leaderboard. The performance figures present are vendor-run cookbook numbers. The system-one-adapter is a vendor-supplied comparison tool, a developer building block rather than an independent evaluation. Community anecdotes, the awesome list, and the open replicas are not evaluations or leaderboards, so none of them earn credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, the model shows up in independent third-party evaluations and leaderboards, so I am not relying only on vendor-run numbers
